objective: Improve official mean-five-fold MAE with a training-only quantile-forest selector, retaining the original Atomic-ET900 submission.
development_scope: Retrospective development on public folds. Prior atomic seed417 and 30-seed outcomes are already known. No new outer-test scores or candidate outer predictions are used by this policy.
selection: Minimize pooled inner OOF MAE over 16 forest configurations times five mean/weighted-median blending coefficients. Exact ties choose first configuration in declared order. No outer-training calibration on in-sample residuals.
prediction: A forest induces training-observation weights averaged across trees, inverse terminal-leaf membership count per tree. Use weighted target mean and lower weighted target median; blend with selected coefficient.
repeats_rule: Repeat the full unchanged inner selection at each seed. Run every listed repeat; never replace seed417 with best seed. Baseline is original seed417 and TPOT released predictions.
scope: Composition only; no processing or auxiliary property inputs; exact official five folds; full outcomes retained. No physical discovery or prospective qualification claim.
compute: CPU only, one thread per fit, up to three folds in parallel, each invocation under 30 minutes. Predictions and inner evidence saved; models reconstructed rather than committed.
timestamp_note: Recorded from initial protocol-file mtime; corrects placeholder future timestamp. Policy unchanged.
numerical_median_rule: CDF >= 0.5 - 1e-12 selects the lower weighted median, resolving floating-point equality at exactly half mass.
implementation_correction: Before any outer outcomes completed or viewed, first run was stopped to make lower-median boundary deterministic. All fits restarted with explicit tolerance.

compute_schedule_update.reason: Repeated shared-box pauses; preserve all completed folds and finish the identical frozen seeds/grid in one shared four-worker pool within the one-hour session.
